This video walks through a simple way to reduce that mental overload and make designing easier, faster, and more consistent.

Many Etsy sellers struggle with design burnout—especially when trying to create fresh graphics for different niches like gifts, holidays, hobbies, or trending topics. That’s where AI design tools for print on demand can make a huge difference. Instead of starting from scratch every time, you can work from ready-made design templates, tweak them with simple prompts, and customize text to fit your niche.

In this video, I share how PODspy helps simplify the design process by giving sellers:
• Ready-to-use design templates
• Easy text customization
• AI remix features for new design ideas
• Faster workflows without advanced design skills

One of the biggest advantages is the remix feature, which helps generate new ideas when you’re feeling stuck. Rather than forcing creativity, you can adapt existing concepts into multiple variations for different audiences or products. This makes it easier to scale your Etsy listings without burning out.

Customizing designs is straightforward—you can change text, adjust themes, and tailor graphics to match specific niches or trends. This is especially helpful for:
• Etsy sellers
• Print on demand beginners
• Side hustle builders
• Small business owners
• Anyone selling shirts, mugs, puzzles, or digital designs
